comments.text: Im in Indiana and work construction. We hired a group of people from Guatemala. At first I heard Spanish, but then I realized I can’t understand some of the words they were saying. Turns out they were speaking a dialect of Mayan mixed with Spanish. Was really cool to hear them talk. One of the guys even said their grandparents cannot speak Spanish at all and only speak Mayan
